entries.title: Psalms 59:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of David; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.>> Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me. {Altaschith...: or, Destroy not} {Michtam: or, A golden Psalm} {defend...: Heb. set me on high}

words.text: me from them that rise up
against me. {Altaschith...: or, Destroy not} {Michtam: or, A golden Psalm} {defend...: Heb. set me on high}

entries.title: Psalms 59:2
segments: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.

entries.title: Psalms 59:3
segments: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not [for] my transgression, nor [for] my sin, O LORD.

words.text: For, lo, they lie in wait

entries.title: Psalms 59:4
segments: They run and prepare themselves without [my] fault: awake to help me, and behold. {help: Heb. meet}

entries.title: Psalms 59:5
segments: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 59:6
segments: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

entries.title: Psalms 59:7
segments: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords [are] in their lips: for who, [say they], doth hear?

entries.title: Psalms 59:8
segments: ¶But thou, O LORD, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.

words.text: at them; thou shalt have all the heathen

entries.title: Psalms 59:9
segments: [Because of] his strength will I wait upon thee: for God [is] my defence. {defence: Heb. high place}

entries.title: Psalms 59:10
segments: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see [my desire] upon mine enemies. {enemies: Heb. observers}

entries.title: Psalms 59:11
segments: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.

entries.title: Psalms 59:12
segments: [For] the sin of their mouth [and] the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying [which] they speak.

entries.title: Psalms 59:13
segments: Consume [them] in wrath, consume [them], that they [may] not [be]: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.

words.text: [them], that they [may] not [be]: and let them know

entries.title: Psalms 59:14
segments: And at evening let them return; [and] let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

entries.title: Psalms 59:15
segments: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied. {for meat: Heb. to eat} {and grudge...: or, if they be not satisfied, then they will stay all night}

words.text: Let them wander up and down
. {for meat: Heb. to eat} {and grudge...: or, if they be not satisfied, then they will stay all night}

entries.title: Psalms 59:16
segments: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.

words.text: : for thou hast been my defence

entries.title: Psalms 59:17
segments: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God [is] my defence, [and] the God of my mercy.
